item.title: Portainer Compose vs Dockge vs Coolify: Best Self-Hosted Docker Compose Management UIs 2026
item.description: Docker Compose is the standard tool for defining and running multi-container applications. But managing dozens of compose files across multiple servers through the CLI becomes unwieldy fast. Self-hosted Docker Compose management UIs solve this problem by providing web interfaces for creating, editing, deploying, and monitoring compose-based applications.
